ideas.name: Monthly G10 Interest Rate Carry
ideas.claim: Sort G10 currencies by one-month interest rates, buy high-rate currencies and sell low-rate currencies, with monthly rebalancing.
ideas.quote: The portfolio composition is determined by sorting currencies on the basis of their prevailing 1-month LIBOR rate, and going long (short) currencies with the highest (lowest) interest rates.
ideas.mechanism: Currency carry from interest rate differentials

rules.entry: Go long high-interest-rate currencies and short low-interest-rate currencies, ranked by prevailing one-month LIBOR.

ideas.claimed_result: The spread-weighted portfolio had an annualized mean return of 5.21% from January 1990 through June 2012.
